title: Sable and the Bakery
author: Hazel Underhill
blurb: Jude Okonkwo, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
